timing: Before any V151 native event or observed target
interpretation: Counterfactual native writes only; no sequential retraining, no addition or language campaign

counter_policy: Artificial pulses do not advance observed-target warmup. Each observed target branch advances its private counter once. No target byte is fed.
scoring: Calibration immediate displacement norms only; lock multipliers before any scored intervention. No loss used to tune gains.
unidentifiable_match: Explicit missing condition, no clipping, per-site tuning or replacement
reported_clone_bandwidth: Known minimum mutable fast/slow/adapt array bytes copied. Temporary copies inside inherited clones are additional and are not claimed measured exactly. CPU and peak RSS measured.
